chronology.cause_and_effect: A guarded river crossing creates a toll settlement and a defensible upper precinct.
An endowed church precinct attracts services and lodging between the crossing and the upper settlement. Parish housing consolidates in D07; a separate charitable religious holding seeds D10.

A market charter consolidates roadside trading into a public square; long burgage plots extend behind narrow shop fronts. Merchant plots in D04 connect the civic center with the crossing rather than merging every institution into one plaza.

Trade expands storage by the landing and work yards beyond the crowded core; the earlier defensive line becomes an internal boundary. The outer defensive belt D09 encloses productive gardens in D08; old plots and institutional precincts remain legible inside it.
A localized market fire prompts mixed masonry rebuilding on surviving plots; rear lanes and unaffected streets retain older fabric.

New households occupy existing approach roads and former field edges while the established center is repaired rather than replaced. S01 grows along the gate approach, while D08 remains cultivated land instead of becoming a uniformly filled suburb.

consistency_checks.rule: Every source district ID resolves explicitly; unknown IDs halt generation instead of defaulting silently.

All seven protected D03 design records retain IDs, recorded dimensions, floor counts, roof topology and r4 palette assignments. Verify reconstruction against records; do not claim original geometry identity while source meshes are absent.
Each era_mix sums to 1 and references chronology IDs; all years end at or before snapshot_year.
Every per-property roof alias resolves to either explicit r2 material values or protected r4 values; no random per-cell color.
Keep route, river and active public/court/service access clear. Document any repurposed source court with functional ownership and replacement access.
Ordinary floor rules never replace authored landmark massing or create competing generic towers.
Do not claim a visible history feature is implemented without a geometry ID and placement verification.
Shop doors face accessible streets; warehouse loading doors face usable aprons; workshop doors face lane or yard.
Only add drainage when outlet and falling route can be verified from terrain; otherwise omit and record omission.
Districts express physical era, function, tenure and land-use differences; documented property consolidation is allowed.
Account for every original1308 ID as retained or explicitly superseded. Resulting building count is not a forced target.

narrative_governance.description: Castle administration, cathedral precinct and a civic council share the city unevenly. Trade supports civic rebuilding while land boundaries and older rights constrain it. No real-city constitution is asserted.
